User.title: User
User.description: Represents a registered school user or moderator profile in the Ministry of Education system. Must sign up with an @moe.om email.

email.description: School or Moderator email ending in @moe.om

role.description: The user role defining their system permissions

wilaya.description: The Wilaya of the school / user

directorate.description: The Directorate of the school / user

appointmentYear.description: The year of appointment to MOE (4 characters)

subject.description: Academic subject specialty assigned to teacher or auditor

Assessment.title: Assessment
Assessment.description: Represents a student test or quiz uploaded by a school to be moderated by MOE moderators.

title.description: Title of the test or quiz

description.description: Brief summary or instructions of the assessment

questions.description: The actual questions or exam questions of the assessment

keyAnswer.description: Answer key and marking guides for moderation

status.description: Current state in the moderation lifecycle

schoolId.description: UID of the school user who uploaded

schoolName.description: Cached school name for list queries

moderatorId.description: UID of the moderator auditing the test, or null

feedback.description: Feedback notes regarding formatting, syllabus matching, or revisions

ActivityLog.title: ActivityLog
ActivityLog.description: Chronological audit trail of changes made to an assessment (uploads, reviews, feedback, edits).

assessmentId.description: ID of the assessment this log pertains to

action.description: Name of action (e.g. Created, Claimed, Approved, Revision Requested)

userId.description: The UID who executed this action

comment.description: Mod comments or notes attached to action

ArchivedForm.title: ArchivedForm
ArchivedForm.description: Represents a finalized school evaluation and auditing ledger, securely archived and electronically signed off by the school director/principal.

School.title: School
School.description: Represents an Educational School in the Ministry database

wilayaId.description: Wilayat ID (e.g. haima, duqm, mahout, jazer)

stampUrl.description: Base64 data URL or Storage download URL of the official school stamp

stampName.description: Original file name of the uploaded stamp

stampUploadedBy.description: Admin name or UID who uploaded the stamp

SchoolReport.title: SchoolReport
SchoolReport.description: Evaluation or operational reports uploaded by MOE Admins for targeted schools

content.description: Text, remarks, or summary of the evaluation report

pdfData.description: Base64 or secure Storage download URL for the uploaded PDF

senderId.description: UID of the Admin who dispatched the report

isRead.description: Flag indicating if the school principal has read this report

readAt.description: Timestamp when the report was opened by the principal

readBy.description: The name of the principal who read the report

users/{userId}.description: User profiles store accessible roles (verified school or moderator)

schools/{schoolId}.description: Educational schools details in Al Wusta

assessments/{assessmentId}.description: Tests and quizzes uploaded by schools, claimable and reviews completed by moderators

assessments/{assessmentId}/logs/{logId}.description: Log of actions of a specific test/quiz

archived_forms/{archiveId}.description: Archived evaluation forms finalized and signed off by the school Director

school_reports/{reportId}.description: Reports dispatched securely by Ministry Admins to specific schools
